violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Medication (26 TAC §746.501(a)(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have a written policy when comes to procedures for dispensing medication or statement that medication is not dispensed to a child under their care.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have a written policy when comes to procedures for dispensing medication or statement that medication is not dispensed to a child under their care.
Based on the information gathered, facility needs to execute Written Operational Policies in regards to medication.

Based on the information received during the investigation, the operation did not provide me with a policy regarding twice-a-day medication. A fever reducer was not administered despite a policy stating that it can be given if a parent is en-route and with a standing order.
During time of inspection, medication policies was not observed in operational policies.
The school accepts epipens for children but policies state they do not accept medication.
Procedures for administering medication need to be updated in the operational policies. Two children enrolled require an EpiPen to be stored at the operation.
